name: mootrace
title: mootrace
blurb: type a handle and get a full grid of its mutuals: every pairing shows who broke the ice first, reading each mutual's entire post history (not a page-capped sample) for their earliest reply to the other — plus a "void graph" listing every mutual pair who've never spoken to each other at all. @norvid-studies.bsky.social asked for both: the grid, then the void graph, in the same thread; @bisks.net tagged the bot to make it real.
